description_json.name: FixedConsonantVowelShiftTwo
description_json.idea: A simple, highly reliable substitution cipher that shifts vowels and consonants independently in opposite directions. Vowels are shifted forward by 2 positions in their closed loop, while consonants are shifted backward by 2 positions in their closed loop. This breaks standard NLP pattern matching while remaining extremely easy for language models to process accurately. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Identify if a character is a letter. If not, leave it unchanged.
2. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U), shift it forward by 2 positions in the cyclic vowel sequence: A -> I, E -> O, I -> U, O -> A, U -> E. Preserve the original case.
3. If it is a consonant, shift it backward by 2 positions in the cyclic consonant sequence: B->Y, C->Z, D->B, F->C, G->D, H->F, J->G, K->H, L->J, M->K, N->L, P->M, Q->N, R->P, S->Q, T->R, V->S, W->T, X->V, Y->W, Z->X. Preserve the original case.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Identify if a character is a letter. If not, leave it unchanged.
2. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U), shift it backward by 2 positions in the cyclic vowel sequence: A -> O, E -> U, I -> A, O -> E, U -> I. Preserve the original case.
3. If it is a consonant, shift it forward by 2 positions in the cyclic consonant sequence: B->D, C->F, D->G, F->H, G->J, H->K, J->L, K->M, L->N, M->P, N->Q, P->R, Q->S, R->T, S->V, T->W, V->X, W->Y, X->Z, Y->B, Z->C. Preserve the original case.
